title: Supply Voltage — Out of Tolerance
description: Main supply voltage P091 = {val} V. Outside ±10% tolerance band ({val2}–{val3} V). DC bus P090 = {val4} V.
probable_cause: Site power quality issue, undersized transformer, or high demand on shared bus.
diagnostic_steps: Measure voltage at main incoming terminal
Log time of occurrence vs. site load profile
remedy: Notify facility maintenance. Install line conditioner if recurring.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
escalation_path: If ELC-MJ-001 is not addressed (stop current operation. machine must be inspected before resuming production.), the fault will escalate in this order: ELC-CR-001, then ELC-SR-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
